description: This file contains unit tests for verifying grain call filtering behavior at the grain level within an Orleans-based system. It uses Xunit for testing and sets up a test cluster with specific configurations. The tests focus on interactions with grain methods and their interception filters.

classes.name: GrainLevelCallFilterTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing grain call filters at the grain level using Orleans testing framework.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up and configuring the Orleans test cluster environment.

methods.name: GrainCallFilter_Incoming_GrainLevel_Without_Global_Filter_Test
methods.description: Unit test method that verifies individual grain call filters function correctly in the absence of global grain call filters. It tests various grain method calls and their expected intercepted or non-intercepted responses.
